items.title: 全球22家企業組織Check Point管理伺服器被入侵，駭客利用已知漏洞取得管理員權限
items.summary: 鎖定Check Point資安設備的攻擊行動，自今年年中開始陸續有事故傳出，本週有資安公司揭露最新一波全球攻擊活動，而成為資安界關注的焦點。

items.title: React Server Components修補未經身分驗證RCE漏洞
items.summary: 開源JavaScript函式庫React維護團隊近日修補 RSC（ React Server Components ）伺服器端元件架構重大漏洞CVE-2026-126187，CVSS 4.0評分達9.5分，問題源自RSC資料傳輸處理缺陷，攻擊者可向支援RSC的框架傳送特製負載，在特定條件下觸發未經驗證的遠端程式碼執行。

items.title: fix(gateway): let a session owner restore their own removed workspace…
items.summary: fix(gateway): let a session owner restore their own removed workspace (#205930) ## Problem When cleanup removes a conversation's worktree, the Control UI replaces the composer with a restore prompt. That prompt is shown to everyone, but `worktrees.restore` required `operator.admin`. A member (`operator.sessions.write`) who clicks Restore gets `FORBIDDEN missing scope: operator.admin` and cannot continue their own conversation. On one Team Gateway this produced 24 refusals from 6 members in two days; one member clicked Restore 16 times. ## Fix - `worktrees.restore` accepts `operator.sessions.write` as a narrow alternative to `operator.admin` (`authorizeOperatorScopesForRequiredScope`, `SESSION_WRITE_METHODS`). - For a non-admin caller, the handler reads the worktree record. If a session owns it, the handler runs the existing session mutation authorization for that session, with the same creator-or-admin rule that unarchive uses (unarchive already restores a session's worktree). `targetOwnership.requireOwner` now includes `worktrees.restore`. - Callers that are not the conversation's creator, and records without an owning session, are still refused. The refusal now names the next step: "Ask an administrator to restore this workspace, or start a new conversation." The text comes from the refusal cause table (`operator-refusal.ts`, cause `workspace-not-owned`). - Admins are unchanged. The Settings → Worktrees page stays admin-only. - The chat restore notice shows Restore only to the conversation's creator (`sharingRole === "owner"`) or an admin. Everyone else sees the next-step sentence instead of a button that would be refused. - No protocol, schema or stored-row change. Decision (recorded here; product call delegated to the PR owner): another member is refused even when their role can write other people's sessions. Restoring a checkout is the same creator-or-admin action as unarchive. Production code is +45/−4 lines. The cut is additive because the missing behavior is a narrow permission. It adds no new hook, flag, state or timer, and it reuses the existing session owner rule. ## User impact A member whose conversation workspace was removed by cleanup can restore it and keep working. Other members see why they cannot, and what to do next, instead of a button that fails. ## Evidence - `src/gateway/server.worktree-owner-restore.test.ts` (real Gateway, trusted-proxy profiles, real worktree): the owner restores their own removed worktree, another member is refused with the next-step text, and the admin restore is unchanged. The test is red on base (another member gets `missing scope: operator.admin` instead of the next-step refusal, and the owner is refused) and green on head. - `ui/src/e2e/chat-worktree-restore.e2e.test.ts`: a non-admin owner sees Restore and sends `worktrees.restore`; a non-owner member sees the sentence and no button. - Real Gateway + real Control UI (isolated scratch Gateway, trusted-proxy member with `operator.read` + `operator.sessions.write`): the member's conversation worktree is removed by cleanup, the member clicks **Restore workspace**, the composer returns, and their next message gets a reply. Base: the click shows "Ask an admin to grant admin access" (`FORBIDDEN missing scope: operator.admin`) and the notice stays. Screenshots below. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 泰味國際委外雲端發票平臺遭異常存取，290人受影響
items.summary: 連鎖餐飲集團瓦城（2729）於11月25日晚間，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，旗下子公司泰味國際使用的委外購物網站服務發生資安事件。委外服務廠商近期在雲端發票平臺發現異常資料存取情形，並於發現後阻擋異常存取行為。此次事件初步評估影響人數為290人，瓦城初步評估對公司營運並無重大影響。

items.title: OpenAI開始合併ChatGPT的Chat與Work介面，預定12月擴大部署共用配額
items.summary: OpenAI於11月宣布將合併對話（Chat）、Work及Codex的token用量配額的計畫。在ChatGPT Work與Codex本月稍早整合用量配額後，OpenAI官方公告開始針對少數Pro用戶合併Chat和Work，預定12月擴大部署共用配額機制。
